description.en: Physically styled WebGL2 shader components for rendering the solar system and sky in React 19.
description.zh: 面向 React 19 的太阳系与天空着色器组件库：基于 WebGL2 物理光照与大气散射算法，渲染真实感天体与天空景象。

content.en: Solaris is a React component library dedicated to rendering celestial bodies and atmospheric scenes with physically styled GLSL shaders. Each of its 14 scenes—from textured terrestrial planets to procedural gas giants and ground-level skies—features responsive composition, pointer lean, directional lighting, and lens flare controls. Components are client-only and export dedicated entry points (such as @cuvii/solaris/sky and @cuvii/solaris/moon) for granular bundle optimization, while automatically handling offscreen pausing and WebGL context loss recovery.
content.zh: Solaris 是专为 React 打造的物理着色器组件库，致力于在浏览器中以极高质量还原太阳系天体与地面天象。全库涵盖地球、月球、太阳、天空等 14 种天体与大气场景，深度模拟了大气消光、折射压扁、云带扰动、镜头眩光以及随指针倾斜的光影变换。各场景支持极细粒度的独立入口导入（如 @cuvii/solaris/sky、@cuvii/solaris/moon），并在底层内置了离屏暂停渲染、WebGL 上下文丢失自动恢复与无障碍动效降级。
